data.one_liner: A fully customizable floating bottom navigation bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating bottom navigation bar widget that can be placed inside a Scaffold. It supports customizable items with icons, titles, and custom widgets, while allowing content to be displayed behind the bar.
use_when: You want a floating style bottom navigation bar in your Flutter app.
You need a customizable navigation bar with icons and titles.
avoid_when: You need a standard non-floating Material bottom navigation bar.
You require complex built-in routing mechanisms.
strengths: Highly customizable with border radius parameters and item builders.
Supports null-safety and runs across multiple platforms.
Easy to integrate into existing Scaffold widgets.
weaknesses: Limited built-in animation customization mentioned in documentation.
Relies on community contributions for extended features.
data.setup_notes: No special setup or native configuration required.
data.minimal_example:
Scaffold(
  appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Example')),
  extendBody: true,
  bottomNavigationBar: FloatingNavbar(
    onTap: (int val) {},
    currentIndex: 0,
    items: [
      FloatingNavbarItem(icon: Icons.home, title: 'Home'),
      FloatingNavbarItem(icon: Icons.explore, title: 'Explore'),
    ],
  ),
)
